profiles.notes: The unconditional natural-language proof passed three independent adversarial reviews and exhaustive scaled checks; it is not yet formalized in Lean. ENH-only changes are closed with a joint bound below 2^-105. The sharp primary constant and changes involving both PH and ENH remain open.

sampledProfile.notes: The selected 32-byte pair produced 1,018 collisions in 2³¹ sampled seeds. The appendix distinguishes it from an earlier pair with a different measured rate.
sampledProfile.key: The experiment chooses a 64-bit seed at random, with every possible value equally likely. The two messages are chosen first and do not depend on that seed.
sampledProfile.scope: The experiment keeps XXH3’s standard public constants fixed and varies its seed. It does not describe the separate interface that accepts a custom random secret.
